sn41.7:1.1: ekaṃ samayaṃ āyasmā godatto macchikasaṇḍe viharati ambāṭakavane.
sn41.7:1.2: atha kho citto gahapati yenāyasmā godatto tenupasaṅkami upasaṅkamitvā āyasmantaṃ godattaṃ abhivādetvā ekamantaṃ nisīdi. ekamantaṃ nisinnaṃ kho cittaṃ gahapatiṃ āyasmā godatto etadavoca
sn41.7:1.3: yā cāyaṃ gahapati appamāṇā cetovimutti yā ca ākiñcaññā cetovimutti yā ca suññatā cetovimutti yā ca animittā cetovimutti ime dhammā nānatthā nānābyañjanā udāhu ekatthā byañjanameva nānanti.
sn41.7:1.4: atthi bhante pariyāyo yaṃ pariyāyaṃ āgamma ime dhammā nānatthā ceva nānābyañjanā ca
sn41.7:1.5: atthi pana bhante pariyāyo yaṃ pariyāyaṃ āgamma ime dhammā ekatthā byañjanameva nānanti
sn41.7:2.1: katamo ca bhante pariyāyo yaṃ pariyāyaṃ āgamma ime dhammā nānatthā ceva nānābyañjanā ca.
sn41.7:2.2: idha bhante bhikkhu mettāsahagatena cetasā ekaṃ disaṃ pharitvā viharati. tathā dutiyaṃ. tathā tatiyaṃ. tathā catutthaṃ. iti uddhamadho tiriyaṃ sabbadhi sabbattatāya sabbāvantaṃ lokaṃ mettāsahagatena cetasā vipulena mahaggatena appamāṇena averena abyāpajjhena pharitvā viharati.
sn41.7:2.5: upekkhāsahagatena cetasā ekaṃ disaṃ pharitvā viharati. tathā dutiyaṃ. tathā tatiyaṃ. tathā catutthaṃ. iti uddhamadho tiriyaṃ sabbadhi sabbattatāya sabbāvantaṃ lokaṃ upekkhāsahagatena cetasā vipulena mahaggatena appamāṇena averena abyāpajjhena pharitvā viharati.
sn41.7:3.2: idha bhante bhikkhu sabbaso viññāṇañcāyatanaṃ samatikkamma natthi kiñcīti ākiñcaññāyatanaṃ upasampajja viharati.
sn41.7:4.2: idha bhante bhikkhu araññagato vā rukkhamūlagato vā suññāgāragato vā iti paṭisañcikkhati
sn41.7:5.2: idha bhante bhikkhu sabbanimittānaṃ amanasikārā animittaṃ cetosamādhiṃ upasampajja viharati.
sn41.7:5.4: ayaṃ kho bhante pariyāyo yaṃ pariyāyaṃ āgamma ime dhammā nānatthā ceva nānābyañjanā ca.
sn41.7:6.1: katamo ca bhante pariyāyo yaṃ pariyāyaṃ āgamma ime dhammā ekatthā byañjanameva nānaṃ.
sn41.7:6.2: rāgo bhante pamāṇakaraṇo doso pamāṇakaraṇo moho pamāṇakaraṇo
sn41.7:6.3: te khīṇāsavassa bhikkhuno pahīnā ucchinnamūlā tālāvatthukatā anabhāvaṅgatā āyatiṃ anuppādadhammā.
sn41.7:6.4: yāvatā kho bhante appamāṇā cetovimuttiyo akuppā tāsaṃ cetovimutti aggamakkhāyati.
sn41.7:6.5: sā kho pana akuppā cetovimutti suññā rāgena suññā dosena suññā mohena.
sn41.7:6.6: rāgo kho bhante kiñcanaṃ doso kiñcanaṃ moho kiñcanaṃ
sn41.7:6.7: te khīṇāsavassa bhikkhuno pahīnā ucchinnamūlā tālāvatthukatā anabhāvaṅgatā āyatiṃ anuppādadhammā.
sn41.7:6.8: yāvatā kho bhante ākiñcaññā cetovimuttiyo akuppā tāsaṃ cetovimutti aggamakkhāyati.
sn41.7:6.9: sā kho pana akuppā cetovimutti suññā rāgena suññā dosena suññā mohena.
sn41.7:6.10: rāgo kho bhante nimittakaraṇo doso nimittakaraṇo moho nimittakaraṇo
sn41.7:6.11: te khīṇāsavassa bhikkhuno pahīnā ucchinnamūlā tālāvatthukatā anabhāvaṅgatā āyatiṃ anuppādadhammā.
sn41.7:6.12: yāvatā kho bhante animittā cetovimuttiyo akuppā tāsaṃ cetovimutti aggamakkhāyati.
sn41.7:6.13: sā kho pana akuppā cetovimutti suññā rāgena suññā dosena suññā mohena.
sn41.7:6.14: ayaṃ kho bhante pariyāyo yaṃ pariyāyaṃ āgamma ime dhammā ekatthā byañjanameva nānanti.
sn41.7:6.15: lābhā te gahapati suladdhaṃ te gahapati
sn41.7:6.16: yassa te gambhīre buddhavacane paññācakkhu kamatīti.
